verdict.rationale: A law firm advising start-ups could plausibly publish guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction, so the axis applies. However, the pack contains no evidence of such guidance. The TwoVenture hub offers general start-up guidance across the venture capital life cycle and the venture capital practice page describes advisory services, but neither mentions choosing between Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG or Indian Pvt Ltd, or picking a jurisdiction of incorporation.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
